config.label: Vault used when a call does not name one, and always reachable
config.description: Vault used when a call does not name one, and always reachable. Vaults are the user's own domains of memory, such as code, notes or a journal. Left unset, the server uses the first vault of MNEMO_VAULTS, or DEV when there is no list.

config.label: Comma-separated list of the vaults this server may reach, besides the default
config.description: Comma-separated list of the vaults this server may reach, besides the default. Once set, it is the whole list: a vault left out is refused. Left unset, the server reaches DEV, PERSONAL and SOCIAL.

config.label: Port of the local Mnemosyne OS SDK server the desktop app listens on
config.description: Port of the local Mnemosyne OS SDK server the desktop app listens on.
